$comment: Canonical capability manifest. The TypeScript module (src/lib/effective-capabilities.ts) and the generated Swift contract (native/Packages/JunoNativeKit/Sources/JunoCore/Generated/JunoCapabilityContract.swift) BOTH derive from this file, so the two cannot drift apart by construction — there is nothing to keep in sync, only one thing to change. Regenerate Swift with: node scripts/generate-capability-contract.mjs --output=native/Packages/JunoNativeKit/Sources/JunoCore/Generated/JunoCapabilityContract.swift
